facts.value: not later than the regular payday for the pay period in which employment ended
facts.summary: New Jersey: when an employee is fired or laid off, final wages are due not later than the regular payday for the pay period in which employment ended.
facts.evidence_quote: Whenever an employer discharges an employee, ... or whenever an employee quits, resigns, or leaves employment for any reason, the employer shall pay the employee all wages due not later than the regular payday for the pay period during which the employee's termination, suspension or cessation of employment (whether temporary or permanent) took place
facts.source_title: Selected NJ State Labor Laws and Regulations (N.J.S.A. 34:11-4.3)
facts.source_publisher: New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development

facts.summary: New Jersey basic state minimum wage listed by U.S. DOL: $15.92.
facts.evidence_quote: Basic Minimum Rate (per hour): $15.92 Premium Pay After Designated Hours 1 : Weekly - 40 The minimum wage is adjusted annually based on a set formula. There is a minimum wage of $15.23 per hour for employers who employ fewer than 6 people and employees engaged in seasonal employment.
facts.source_title: State Minimum Wage Laws (U.S. DOL Wage and Hour Division)
facts.source_publisher: U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division
facts.notes: Local (city or county) minimum wages are not included. Scheduled January 1, 2027 increases are not reflected until DOL updates the page.

facts.summary: New Jersey is not listed with a final 2026 FUTA credit reduction, so the effective FUTA rate is 0.6% on the first $7,000 per employee (if the full 5.4% state credit applies).
facts.evidence_quote: State not listed in the Final 2026 FUTA Credit Reductions table.
facts.source_title: Final 2026 Federal Unemployment Tax Act (FUTA) Credit Reductions (updated November 10, 2026)
facts.source_publisher: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration

facts.applies_to: Fiscal rate year July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027
facts.summary: New Jersey base new employer UI rate: 2.8%.
facts.evidence_quote: Unemployment and Temporary Disability contribution rates in New Jersey are assigned on a fiscal year basis (July 1 st to June 30). ... Employer: 0.026825 0.00500 0.001175 0.000000 July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027
facts.source_title: Employer Rate Information (NJ Department of Labor and Workforce Development)
facts.source_publisher: New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development
facts.notes: DOL value equals the state's published total: UI 2.6825% plus workforce funds (WF/SWF) 0.1175% = 2.8% (NJ LWD, fiscal year July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027). Employer TDI 0.5% is separate and not included. The 2027 taxable wage base is already published: $46,400.

facts.applies_to: Rate year July 1 to June 30 (NJ fiscal year; per DOL Significant Provisions)
facts.summary: New Jersey experience-rated UI tax rates range from 0.5% to 5.8%.
facts.source_title: Significant Provisions of State Unemployment Insurance Laws, Effective July 2026
facts.source_publisher: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration, Office of Unemployment Insurance
facts.notes: DOL footnote 3: min/max rates apply only to experience-rated employers and exclude surtaxes, surcharges and non-UI taxes. Footnote 4: new employer rate shown is the base rate; higher rates may apply by industry or other factors. DOL notes the report is not an official interpretation of state law. DOL prints footnote marker(s) 7 on the maximum rate. Footnote 7: tax rate shown is reduced in some circumstances due to certain UI administration or non-UI taxes paid. Footnote 8: rate year is July 1 through June 30. NJ rates are assigned on a July 1 to June 30 fiscal year (NJ LWD rate information page, https://www.nj.gov/labor/ea/employer-services/rate-info/).

facts.summary: New Jersey state unemployment taxable wage base: $44,800 per employee.
facts.source_title: Significant Provisions of State Unemployment Insurance Laws, Effective July 2026
facts.source_publisher: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration, Office of Unemployment Insurance

facts.applies_to: Fiscal rate year July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027
facts.summary: New Jersey new employer rate, UI plus workforce funds: 2.8% (2.6825% + 0.1175%), fiscal year 2026-27.
facts.source_title: Employer Rate Information (NJ Department of Labor and Workforce Development)
facts.source_publisher: New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development
facts.notes: Sum of the employer UI (0.026825) and WF/SWF (0.001175) columns. Employer TDI (0.005) is a disability contribution and is not included.
